Dragon

Released November 24, 2003 · 100 cards

Dragon is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on November 24, 2003. Its main set has 97 cards, plus 3 secret rares numbered beyond the set (100 in total). It includes 93 Pokémon, 7 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

24 illustrators worked on Dragon. Most cards: Midori Harada (10), Atsuko Nishida (9), Hajime Kusajima (9), Mitsuhiro Arita (9), Ken Sugimori (8), Hisao Nakamura (6), Hikaru Koike (5), Kagemaru Himeno (5).
